Bakertilly._comment: Bangalore site, one counter, TWO non-veg dishes (themes Mon/Thu = mix, Tue = south, Wed = biryani, Fri = north). The non-veg station runs on the BIRYANI DAY ONLY and serves chicken dry there — the client's clarification, which replaces the earlier reading that it ran daily with a dry added on Wednesday. Its biryani-day list ('indian bread, rasam, veg curry, flavoured rice, white rice and salad — other will be blank') and its curd rule ('daily curd except of biryani day it is raita') disagree about the curd on a Wednesday; the client called that an outlier, so `curd_side` is KEPT there as a raita and nothing else is inferred from the conflict. 'Daily curd except on the biryani day it is raita' is the city ruleset's `curd_raita_logic` and is not restated here.

rules._comment: …'and it will be chicken dry'. Both Wednesday cells are dry, so `count: 2` over the two dry flags. The city rule `nonveg_main_daily_pair` is DISABLED for this client rather than overridden: it composes a 2-4 dish counter as one dry plus one regional chicken gravy, and on a biryani day as biryani plus gravy — both of which put a gravy on the plate the client says is dry. `count` caps itself to what the day can serve, so if the biryani-day pool offers only one dry the component relaxes to one and diagnose() reports it (the theme filter keeps the dry families available at 2+ slots — CLAUDE.md note 16).
